summary.one_liner: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and talks to you through chat apps like Discord, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, and iMessage.
summary.what_it_does: OpenClaw runs a local Gateway that acts as the control plane for sessions, tools, events, and channel connections. The Control UI, CLI, and TUI connect to that Gateway, and channels bring the assistant into 20+ messaging services. Companion apps and nodes add voice, Canvas, camera, screen, and device-local actions on supported platforms. Models and agent harnesses (Claude, Codex, local models) are swappable plugins, and tools, skills, and plugins extend what the assistant can do. State, memory, and credentials are stored on the user's hardware. The same Gateway can run as a personal assistant on a laptop or as a shared team deployment, with configuration as the only difference.
use_cases: personal AI assistant on your own computer
chat with an AI assistant over Telegram, Slack, or WhatsApp
swap between Claude, Codex, and local models
automate tools and skills through chat channels
voice, camera, or screen actions from companion apps
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (macOS / Linux / WSL2 installer; the URL was missing from the README)
npm install -g openclaw@latest --allow-scripts=openclaw  (if you already manage Node.js; Node 24.22.1+ or 26.12.1+)
stack: TypeScript-based plugin SDK (ClawHub for sharing plugins)
notable: Runs locally: state, memory, and credentials stay on your hardware
Model providers and agent harnesses are swappable plugins
Untrusted inbound DMs: unknown senders are paired by default and must be approved
Same Gateway works for a personal laptop or a shared team deployment
Stewarded by the OpenClaw Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3)
caveats: Tools run on the host for the main session unless sandboxing is configured
Development requires pnpm; plain npm install at the repo root is not supported
npm install flag --allow-scripts depends on npm version (npm 11.15 and earlier omit it)
keywords: mac ios android windows linux ai app
